title: Design bounded fetch and result-cleanup pipeline
description: Compare direct HTTP, Markdown content negotiation, Readability/Turndown, PDF, browser/JS fallbacks, caching, and API-result normalization. Define a minimal layered design without weakening SSRF, untrusted-content, byte, deadline, or cost boundaries.

logs.msg: Architect report recommends shared pure result cleanup, conservative URL identity, Markdown negotiation, no default browser/cache; identifies provider-local dedup and format metadata gaps.
